interception.hub.description: Multi-device Interception driver hub exposing up to 4 keyboard outputs and 4 mouse outputs with a shared loop-back Return / Action input.

return.label: Return / Action
return.description: Loop-back stroke decision (suppress/pass + replacement actions) or direct hardware injection port.

all.label: All Events
all.description: Universal monitor output receiving events from all active channels, or all connected devices when Monitor All Devices is enabled.

kb1.label: KB 1
kb1.description: Stroke events captured from keyboard channel 1.

kb2.label: KB 2
kb2.description: Stroke events captured from keyboard channel 2.

kb3.label: KB 3
kb3.description: Stroke events captured from keyboard channel 3.

kb4.label: KB 4
kb4.description: Stroke events captured from keyboard channel 4.

mouse1.label: Mouse 1
mouse1.description: Stroke events captured from mouse channel 1.

mouse2.label: Mouse 2
mouse2.description: Stroke events captured from mouse channel 2.

mouse3.label: Mouse 3
mouse3.description: Stroke events captured from mouse channel 3.

mouse4.label: Mouse 4
mouse4.description: Stroke events captured from mouse channel 4.

active.label: Active
active.description: Enable hardware hooks for configured hub channels. Disabled by default for safety.

monitorAll.label: Monitor All Devices
monitorAll.description: Capture all connected keyboards and mice on the All Events port for device discovery and probing.

defaultAction.label: Default Action
defaultAction.description: Fallback decision applied if the loop-back times out or omits an explicit suppress flag.

kb1Filter.label: KB 1 Filter
kb1Filter.description: Hardware ID substring, HWID#N instance selector, or explicit keyboard slot (1–10) for channel KB 1.

kb2Filter.label: KB 2 Filter
kb2Filter.description: Hardware ID substring, HWID#N instance selector, or explicit keyboard slot (1–10) for channel KB 2.

kb3Filter.label: KB 3 Filter
kb3Filter.description: Hardware ID substring, HWID#N instance selector, or explicit keyboard slot (1–10) for channel KB 3.

kb4Filter.label: KB 4 Filter
kb4Filter.description: Hardware ID substring, HWID#N instance selector, or explicit keyboard slot (1–10) for channel KB 4.

mouse1Filter.label: Mouse 1 Filter
mouse1Filter.description: Hardware ID substring, HWID#N instance selector, or explicit mouse slot (11–20) for channel Mouse 1.

mouse2Filter.label: Mouse 2 Filter
mouse2Filter.description: Hardware ID substring, HWID#N instance selector, or explicit mouse slot (11–20) for channel Mouse 2.

mouse3Filter.label: Mouse 3 Filter
mouse3Filter.description: Hardware ID substring, HWID#N instance selector, or explicit mouse slot (11–20) for channel Mouse 3.

mouse4Filter.label: Mouse 4 Filter
mouse4Filter.description: Hardware ID substring, HWID#N instance selector, or explicit mouse slot (11–20) for channel Mouse 4.

captureMove.label: Capture Mouse Move
captureMove.description: Include relative mouse movement events on mouse channels (off by default to reduce event volume).

decisionTimeoutMs.label: Decision Timeout (ms)
decisionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a loop-back decision before applying Default Action.

dllPath.label: DLL Path
dllPath.description: Optional explicit path to interception.dll. Leave empty to auto-detect.

interception.device.description: Captures hardware keyboard or mouse strokes from a single Interception device slot (matched by Hardware ID or explicit slot) and accepts suppress/replace decisions or direct injections on Return / Action.

return.label: Return / Action
return.description: Loop-back stroke decision (suppress/pass + sendKeys/sendMouse) or direct hardware injection when no correlationId is pending.

out.label: Stroke Event
out.description: Emits captured hardware stroke basket containing correlationId, device metadata, key/button, and phase.

active.label: Active
active.description: Enable hardware hook for the matched device. Disabled by default for safety.

deviceKind.label: Device Kind
deviceKind.description: Type of hardware device to match and capture.

hardwareIdFilter.label: Hardware ID
hardwareIdFilter.description: Case-insensitive Hardware ID substring persistent across USB port changes, or * for the first device of the selected kind.

instanceIndex.label: Instance Index
instanceIndex.description: 1-based index used to distinguish multiple identical devices matching the same Hardware ID filter.

explicitSlot.label: Explicit Slot
explicitSlot.description: 0 = match by Hardware ID; 1–10 for keyboard slots or 11–20 for mouse slots.

captureMove.label: Capture Mouse Move
captureMove.description: Include relative mouse movement events (applies only when Device Kind is Mouse).

defaultAction.label: Default Action
defaultAction.description: Fallback decision applied if the loop-back times out or omits an explicit suppress flag.

decisionTimeoutMs.label: Decision Timeout (ms)
decisionTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for a loop-back decision before applying Default Action.

dllPath.label: DLL Path
dllPath.description: Optional explicit path to interception.dll. Leave empty to auto-detect.

testKey.label: Test Trigger Key
testKey.description: Key or mouse button name emitted when manually triggering this node for flow testing.

interception.hotkey-switch.description: Evaluates multiple hotkey and mouse button remap rules together with unified modifier buffering, timeout handling, and optional delayed replay of unmatched modifiers.

return.label: Return
return.description: Connect back to Interception Device/Hub [Return / Action]. Carries all stroke decisions and delayed modifier replays.

matched.label: Matched
matched.description: Optional tap emitted only when a rule matches (for example, to Debug, OBS, or downstream actions).

rules.label: Hotkey Rules
rules.description: List of From -> To hotkey, chord, or mouse button remap rules evaluated together.

replayUnmatchedModifier.label: Replay Unmatched Mod
replayUnmatchedModifier.description: If a prefix modifier (such as LWin) is pressed and no rule matches, replay it to Windows so standard shortcuts and bare taps continue to work.

chordWindowMs.label: Replay Window (ms)
chordWindowMs.description: Auto-replay a held prefix modifier after this timeout if no trigger arrives (0 = wait until another key is pressed or the modifier is released).

targetKeyboardFilter.label: Target KB Filter
targetKeyboardFilter.description: Optional Hardware ID substring selecting which keyboard slot injects keyboard actions triggered from a mouse.

interception.probe.description: Live mini-terminal for inspecting hardware strokes. When armed with blocking enabled, suppresses original input while showing exact device slots and key/button codes; auto-disarms on inactivity, max duration, or Esc.

in.label: Event
in.description: Incoming stroke basket from Interception Device or Hub.

return.label: Return
return.description: Connect back to Interception Device/Hub [Return / Action]. Suppresses while armed with blocking enabled; passes through otherwise.

observed.label: Observed
observed.description: Optional tap forwarding every observed stroke event (for example, to a Debug node).

blockWhenArmed.label: Block When Armed
blockWhenArmed.description: Suppress original strokes while armed so inspected keys and buttons do not trigger Windows actions.

idleTimeoutSec.label: Idle Auto-Off (s)
idleTimeoutSec.description: Automatically disarm capture if no events arrive for this many seconds.

maxDurationSec.label: Max Armed (s)
maxDurationSec.description: Hard safety cap on how long blocking capture can remain armed.

maxLines.label: Terminal Lines
maxLines.description: Maximum number of recent stroke lines displayed in the live mini-terminal.

interception.stroke-action.description: Matches a configured key or mouse button and phase, marks the basket to suppress or pass the original stroke, and optionally attaches replacement key chords, sequences, or mouse actions.

matched.label: Matched
matched.description: Emitted when the stroke matches Match Key and Phase, with decision and replacement action properties attached.

unmatched.label: Other
unmatched.description: Emitted unchanged when the stroke does not match.

matchKey.label: Match Key
matchKey.description: Key or mouse button name(s) separated by commas, or * to match any stroke.

suppress.label: Suppress
suppress.description: Controls whether the original hardware stroke is suppressed, passed through, or left unchanged.

sendAction.label: Send Action
sendAction.description: Optional replacement key chord, comma-separated sequence, or mouse button action.

sendMode.label: Send Mode
sendMode.description: Controls when replacement strokes are generated relative to key down and up events.

targetKeyboardFilter.label: Target KB Filter
targetKeyboardFilter.description: Optional Hardware ID substring selecting which keyboard slot injects replacement keyboard actions.

interception.chord-matcher.description: Detects a configured modifier + trigger key chord within a time window using in-memory held state. Wire both Matched and Other back to Return / Action for immediate loop-back decisions.

matched.label: Matched
matched.description: Emitted when Trigger Key is pressed while Modifier Key is held within Chord Window.

other.label: Other
other.description: Emitted for modifier strokes, trigger release, and non-matching keys (carrying suppress flags when enabled).

modifierKey.label: Modifier Key
modifierKey.description: Key that must be held before pressing Trigger Key.

triggerKey.label: Trigger Key
triggerKey.description: Second key pressed while Modifier Key is held to complete the chord.

suppressModifier.label: Suppress Modifier
suppressModifier.description: Suppress the original modifier key down and up events.

suppressTrigger.label: Suppress Trigger
suppressTrigger.description: Suppress the trigger key down and matching release when the chord fires.

sendAction.label: Send Action
sendAction.description: Optional replacement key chord, sequence, or mouse action injected when the chord matches.

chordWindowMs.label: Chord Window (ms)
chordWindowMs.description: Maximum time between modifier press and trigger press (0 = unlimited while held).
